title: Detailed watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='27' y='45' width='36' height='12' rx='6' fill='#62b8f0'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='41' rx='12' ry='3.5' fill='#5fd0ff'/>

  <path d='M21 54 C12 54 12 70 21 70 L21 67 C15 67 15 57 21 57 Z' fill='#62b8f0'/>
  <!-- flower decoration on body -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='1.3' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffd93b'/>
